preamble: Voicing of the bilabial ejective [pʼ] to [b]. In Chechen and Ingush, single non-initial Proto-Nakh ejectives after a vowel or sonorant became voiced, as with *ṭ > d and *ḳ > g. Bats keeps the ejective. The labial is rare in the lexicon, and only one clear Proto-Nakh etymon is available (*nHaaṗ 'sleep' > Chechen на̄б /naːb/), so the change is given with low certainty. Initial pʼ is kept (*ṗHenṭo 'rib' > Chechen пӏенда).
phoneticEffects: Voicing, Loss of Glottalization, Airstream Change

examples.note: Ingush на̄б; Bats ნჵაპ keeps the ejective.
